Title: Rohan's Day

Cast

1. Rohan - 12 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Anita - 36 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Karan - 42 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt
4. Pihu - 8 years, friend
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Rohan stands in the park. Anita stands near him.]

Anita: "What lovely weather!"

[Rohan throws the ball to Mother.]

Rohan: "Okay, Mom."

[Rohan catches the ball.]

Rohan: "Mom, look at this."

[Rohan goes down the slide.]

Anita: "Hey, look at that!"

[Rohan plays with his dog.]

Anita (excited): "What happened?"

[Rohan does push-ups.]

Rohan: "That's great!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Rohan stands in the courtyard. Anita stands near him.]

Anita: "What a nice place."

[Rohan feeds the dog.]

Rohan: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Rohan milks the cow.]

Rohan (laughing): "Slowly, take it easy."

[A cat walks along the wall.]

Rohan: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Rohan pats his horse.]

Rohan (softly): "Mom, are you okay?"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

Rohan: "Mom, look over here."

[Rohan knocks on the door.]

Rohan: "How beautiful!"

[Rohan slams the door shut.]

Rohan: "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 4: The courtyard - Day

[It is raining heavily. Rohan stands in the courtyard. Anita and Pihu stand near him.]

Rohan: "What a nice place."

[Rohan opens his umbrella.]

Anita (excited): "This is amazing!"

[Rohan puts on his raincoat.]

Pihu: "I knew it!"

[The rain stops.]

Rohan (excited): "I really enjoyed today."
